title: Weather observer injured in an encounter and given a medical discharge

tellings.quote: One observer was even injured in an encounter with something and given a medical discharge.

plain: In the 1960s, a weather observer working on the Indian Springs testing ranges in the Nevada desert is said to have been hurt in an encounter with something unknown, and then let go from the military on medical grounds. Michels mentions it in passing, without naming a source, while introducing his guest Charles Hall, a former Air Force weather observer who says he spent three years among tall white aliens on those ranges. If it were true, it would mean Hall was not the only observer out there who met something strange, and that one of them paid for it with his health.
